verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL public API with an interactive explorer for querying and configuring the platform, plus a CLI (newrelic-cli) built on top of it for scripted entity search/tagging/deployment markers, giving an AI-native user a documented, machine-drivable interface. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent hands-on developer confirmation of API robustness/rate limits.
